Built the policy details screen at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- **Header**: policy name, number, and a color-coded status badge (active/renewal-due/lapsed).
- **Tabs** (Cover, Documents, Payments): accessible `role="tablist"`/`tab`/`tabpanel` with arrow-key navigation.
- **Cover**: two columns of included/excluded items with check/cross markers.
- **Documents**: 4 mock files with name, format, size, and a Download button each.
- **Payments**: next payment (amount, due date, method) plus a history list of the last three payments.

Since `node_modules` isn't installed in this sandbox (no `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` types available to inspect), I built the UI from semantic HTML/CSS rather than guessing at component APIs, but wired styling to Strata design tokens (`--strata-color-*`, `--strata-space-*`, `--strata-font-*`, `--strata-radius-*`) confirmed via `app.css`, each with a sensible fallback value so it renders correctly even if a given token name doesn't exist, and adapts automatically per brand/scheme when it does. Logical CSS properties (`margin-inline`, `border-block-end`, `text-align: end`, etc.) are used throughout for correct RTL rendering in `ar-AE`.
